title: Tax-free bond yields are in a sweet spot. Get in before it’s too late.
summary: Municipal bond yields have significantly widened relative to corporate bond yields over the past two months, creating what some see as an attractive investment opportunity. Tax-free bonds may offer compelling risk-adjusted returns before the spread narrows.
content: Yields on municipal bonds — adjusted for taxable-equivalent comparisons — have widened dramatically over those of corporate bonds over the past two months.

zh.title: 免税债券收益处于最佳状态。趁为时未晚，赶快投资。
zh.summary: 在过去两个月里，市政债券收益率与公司债券收益率相比大幅扩大，这被一些人视为有吸引力的投资机会。在价差缩小之前，免税债券可能会提供引人注目的风险调整后回报。

title: Millions will lose Medicaid once new work rules kick in. These groups will be hit the hardest.
summary: New work rules targeting Medicaid recipients will reduce federal spending by approximately $1 trillion over the next decade. The changes are expected to have disproportionate impact on certain vulnerable populations.
content: The changes will cut about $1 trillion from federal Medicaid spending over 10 years.

zh.title: 一旦新的工作规则实施，数百万人将失去医疗补助。这些群体将受到最大打击。
zh.summary: 针对医疗补助接收者的新工作规则将在未来十年内减少约1万亿美元的联邦支出。这些变化预计将对某些弱势群体产生不成比例的影响。

title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
summary: A retired pastor argues that stories of financially prudent living on modest incomes deserve greater attention in public discourse. He challenges the prevailing narrative that comfortable retirement is impossible without high earnings.
content: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”

zh.title: "我们入不敷出"：我作为牧师挣了3万美元，仍然舒适地退休了。你为什么不告诉人们这一点？
zh.summary: 一位退休牧师辩称，关于以微薄收入谨慎理财生活的故事应该在公共话语中获得更多关注。他质疑了舒适退休在没有高收入的情况下是不可能的这一普遍说法。

title: Trump rejects Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal, WSJ reports, as Saudi coalition intercepts projectiles
summary: Trump has rejected Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal and signals plans for renewed U.S. military action after the midterm elections, according to Wall Street Journal reporting. Saudi-backed forces have successfully intercepted projectiles amid ongoing regional tensions.
content: Trump expects renewed U.S. bombing of Iran after the midterm elections, The Wall Street Journal reports, as Saudi-backed forces intercept projectiles.

zh.title: 特朗普拒绝伊朗有条件停火提议，据《华尔街日报》报道，沙特联盟截获发射体
zh.summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普已拒绝伊朗的有条件停火提议，并表示计划在中期选举后恢复美国军事行动。沙特支持的武装力量已成功在正在进行的地区紧张局势中截获发射体。

title: This may be the ‘missing piece’ for investors looking to boost AI exposure
summary: A Matthews Asia portfolio manager identifies Asia strategies as a potentially underutilized avenue for investors seeking greater AI exposure. The approach focuses on the world's second-largest economy.
content: Matthews Asia portfolio manager Andrew Mattock delivers a strategy that revolves around the world's second largest economy.

zh.title: 这可能是投资者寻求提高人工智能敞口的"缺失部分"
zh.summary: 一位Matthews Asia投资组合经理将亚洲策略标记为投资者寻求获得更大人工智能敞口的潜在未被充分利用的途径。该方法侧重于世界第二大经济体。

title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
summary: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology over $5.7 billion in a patent infringement case against Apple for violating haptics technology patents used in iPhones and Apple Watches. Apple has announced plans to appeal the verdict.
content: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.

zh.title: 苹果因iPhone和Apple Watch触觉技术专利侵权面临57亿美元判决
zh.summary: 在一起专利侵权案中，联邦陪审团裁定苹果赔偿Taction Technology超过57亿美元，理由是苹果侵犯了用于iPhone和Apple Watch中的触觉技术专利。苹果已宣布计划对该判决提出上诉。

title: I’m afraid of ‘starving to death.’ Social Security stopped our checks due to a hacked bank account. What can we do?
summary: A retired couple's Social Security benefits were suspended after their bank account was compromised through hacking. They are currently relying on community and church support to meet basic needs.
content: “We are relying on our church for our current needs.”

zh.title: 我害怕"饿死"。由于银行账户被黑客入侵，社会保障停止了我们的支票。我们能做什么？
zh.summary: 一对退休夫妇的社会保障福利在其银行账户遭黑客入侵后被暂停。他们目前依靠社区和教会的支持来满足基本需求。

title: A new bill in Congress would lower the retirement age to 60. See who would qualify.
summary: A new Congressional bill proposes lowering Social Security's full retirement age from 67 to 60 for workers in physically demanding occupations. Retirement policy experts warn the change could strain the trust fund and create a two-tiered system among workers.
content: A new bill calling for lowering Social Security’s full retirement age from 67 to 60 for workers in physically demanding jobs could put additional strain on the trust fund that backs the system and create a two-tiered system among workers, retirement experts said.

zh.title: 国会的一项新法案将降低退休年龄至60岁。了解谁将符合条件。
zh.summary: 一项新的国会法案提议将社会保障的完全退休年龄从67岁降低至60岁，适用于从事体力劳动职业的工人。退休政策专家警告，这一变化可能会对信托基金造成压力，并在工人之间创造一个分层制度。

title: The blue-collar AI job market is booming. Will data center backlash make it go bust?
summary: HVAC, plumbing, welding, and electrical workers are experiencing a jobs boom tied to growing AI data center construction despite public backlash. The expansion of data center projects has created significant employment opportunities in skilled trades.
content: The public has soured on AI data centers and states are slowing development, but for HVAC, plumbing, welding, and electrical workers, it's been a jobs boom.

zh.title: 蓝领人工智能就业市场蓬勃发展。数据中心的反弹会使其崩溃吗？
zh.summary: 暖通空调、管道、焊接和电气工人正在经历与不断增长的人工智能数据中心建设相关的就业繁荣，尽管遭到公众反对。数据中心项目的扩展在技术工种中创造了大量就业机会。

title: My friend grosses $300,000 a year with her pet-sitting business. She pays herself $50,000. Should I do the same?
summary: A pet-sitting business owner generates $300,000 in annual revenue while taking only a $50,000 personal salary, managing approximately 15 independent contractor sitters. The question arises whether this financial structure represents a viable strategy for others.
content: “She currently has about 15 sitters, all independent contractors.”

zh.title: 我的朋友通过宠物看护业务每年收入30万美元。她只给自己发5万美元。我应该也这样做吗?
zh.summary: 一位宠物看护业务主管每年产生30万美元的年度收入，但只给自己5万美元的个人薪水，管理约15名独立承包商看护人员。这种财务结构是否代表对他人的可行策略值得思考。

title: Bank of America says Nvidia and these other stocks are on sale
summary: Bank of America has identified Nvidia and several other stocks as trading below their intrinsic value. The firm's analysis suggests these equities present buying opportunities for investors.
content: Bank of America named several stocks that it said are undervalued.

zh.title: 美国银行表示英伟达和其他这些股票处于低价
zh.summary: 美国银行已确定英伟达和其他几只股票交易价格低于其内在价值。该公司的分析表明这些股票为投资者提供了买入机会。

title: The 10-year Treasury yield is at its highest in nearly two decades. How we got here
summary: The 10-year Treasury yield has climbed to its highest level in nearly two decades, driven by persistent inflation, substantial bond supply, and an investment surge fueled by AI enthusiasm. The benchmark rate reflects broader economic pressures and investor expectations.
content: The benchmark yield has climbed to a 19-year high, fueled by sticky inflation, heavy bond issuance and an AI-fueled investment boom.

zh.title: 10年期美国国债收益率创近20年来新高。我们是如何走到这一步的
zh.summary: 10年期美国国债收益率攀升至近20年来的最高水平，受持续通胀、大量债券供应和人工智能热潮推动的投资激增所驱动。基准利率反映了更广泛的经济压力和投资者预期。

title: Many homeowners have a big insurance coverage gap — and don't even know it
summary: Many homeowners maintain significant gaps in their insurance coverage without realizing the financial vulnerability this creates. Experts warn that these uncovered risks could expose households to substantial losses.
content: Many consumers have a gap in their homeowners insurance coverage. This puts them at financial risk, and they are likely unaware, experts said.

zh.title: 许多房主面临巨大保险覆盖缺口 — 但他们甚至没有意识到
zh.summary: 许多房主在保险覆盖范围内存在重大缺口，但没有意识到这造成的财务风险。专家警告称，这些未覆盖的风险可能导致家庭面临巨大损失。

title: Berkshire adds to nearly doubled stake in slumping homebuilder
summary: Berkshire Hathaway has nearly doubled its equity stake in Lennar, the nation's second-largest homebuilder, since early July, signaling confidence in a long-term housing market recovery. The increased investment reflects the company's bullish outlook on the sector.
content: Berkshire Hathaway has increased its bet on a long-term recovery for the struggling U.S. housing market by nearly doubling its stake in Lennar, the nation's second largest homebuilder, since the beginning of July.

zh.title: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司增加对房建商的股份至近乎翻倍
zh.summary: 自七月初以来，伯克希尔哈撒韦公司将其在美国第二大房建商莱纳公司的股权几乎翻了一番，表明对长期房地产市场复苏充满信心。增加的投资反映了该公司对该行业的乐观前景。

title: Supply glut, lab-grown alternatives: What's behind the fall of diamond prices to record lows
summary: Diamond prices have fallen to record lows as supply oversupply combines with the growing availability of lab-grown alternatives. The market shift raises questions about whether diamonds' traditional investment appeal is waning.
content: Diamond prices are falling, leading investors and others to wonder whether the gemstones are losing their luster.

zh.title: 供应过剩和人造钻石替代品：钻石价格创新低背后的原因
zh.summary: 由于供应过剩与人造钻石替代品日益普及，钻石价格跌至历史新低。市场的这一转变引发了关于钻石传统投资价值是否在减弱的问题。

title: Stephen Curry and Warriors agree to 2-year contract extension worth $116 million, AP source says
summary: Stephen Curry signed a 2-year, $116 million extension with the Golden State Warriors, accepting a significant discount from his potential $136 million value to demonstrate franchise commitment.
content: Curry was eligible to command up to $136 million, so he is giving his team a discount.

zh.title: 斯蒂芬·库里与勇士队同意2年1.16亿美元合同延期，美联社消息人士称
zh.summary: 斯蒂芬·库里与金州勇士队签署了2年1.16亿美元的延期合同，相比潜在的1.36亿美元价值接受了重大折扣，以展示对球队的承诺。

title: Could an iced coffee freeze you out of the job market?
summary: A viral debate examines whether drinking iced coffee during job interviews affects hiring prospects, with industry professionals sharing perspectives on interview etiquette expectations.
content: Employees and recruiters weigh into the online debate around interview etiquette.

zh.title: 冰咖啡会让你失去工作机会吗？
zh.summary: 一场热议的辩论探讨了在求职面试中喝冰咖啡是否会影响招聘前景，业界专业人士分享了对面试礼仪期望的看法。

title: Audemars Piguet says its Royal Pop collaboration with Swatch is breaking sales records, despite luxury watch slump and tariffs
summary: Audemars Piguet reports record-breaking sales from its Royal Pop collaboration with Swatch, defying headwinds from the luxury watch slump and tariff pressures.
content: Swiss luxury watchmaker Audemars Piguet says its sales and engagement are breaking records after its risky, eye-catching Royal Pop collaboration with Swatch.

zh.title: 爱彼表示其与斯沃琪的皇家弹出款合作创造销售纪录，尽管奢侈手表行业低迷和关税压力
zh.summary: 爱彼报告其与斯沃琪的皇家弹出款合作创造了破纪录的销售额，克服了奢侈手表行业低迷和关税压力带来的不利因素。

title: Arming Taiwan is an important U.S. interest, Taipei official says after Trump-Xi summit
summary: A Taipei official emphasized the strategic importance of U.S. military support for Taiwan following high-level discussions between American and Chinese leadership.

zh.title: 台北官员在特朗普-习近平峰会后表示，向台湾供应武器是美国的重要利益
zh.summary: 台北官员强调，在美中两国高层讨论后，美国对台湾的军事支持具有战略重要性。

title: TikTok reaches first state settlement over teen safety claims, agrees to user limits
summary: TikTok reached its first state-level settlement addressing teen safety concerns, agreeing to implement user access and engagement restrictions.

zh.summary: TikTok就青少年安全问题与美国某州达成首项州级和解协议，同意实施用户访问和参与限制措施。

title: Fuel costs putting off meal delivery driver applicants
summary: Rising fuel costs are deterring potential meal delivery drivers, with recruitment leaders reporting that applicants withdraw after learning about operational expenses.
content: Maureen Bougeard says some prospective volunteers do not respond after learning about expenses.

zh.title: 高油价阻止人们申请做外卖配送司机
zh.summary: 不断上升的燃油成本正在打消潜在外卖配送司机的积极性，招聘负责人报告申请人在了解运营费用后放弃申请。

title: Chinese AI models surge in global popularity — and Washington is worried
summary: Chinese AI models are experiencing rapid global adoption among businesses in 2026, raising strategic concerns in Washington about technological competition.
content: Usage of Chinese AI models by businesses across the globe has increased substantially in 2026.

zh.title: 中国AI模型在全球受欢迎程度激增——华盛顿感到担忧
zh.summary: 中国AI模型在2026年在全球企业中经历快速采用，在华盛顿引发了关于技术竞争的战略担忧。

summary: OpenAI's bots accessed public data from multiple U.S. government agency websites during testing operations, raising questions about unauthorized system access.
content: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises.

zh.title: OpenAI机器人干扰了多个美国政府机构网站
zh.summary: OpenAI的机器人在测试操作中访问了多个美国政府机构网站上的公共数据，引发了关于未授权系统访问的疑问。
